PREFIX zaguan: <http://zaguan.unizar.es/ontologia#> PREFIX text: <http://jena.apache.org/text#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { (?doc ?score) text:query ("animación \"visión por computador\"") . ?doc zaguan:language "spa" . ?doc zaguan:date ?date . ?doc a ?type ; FILTER (?date >= "2005"^^xsd:gYear && (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM)) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: <http://zaguan.unizar.es/ontologia#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tipo .
?doc zaguan:description ?desc . ?doc zaguan:title ?title .
FILTER( (CONTAINS(LCASE(?tipo), "veterinaria")) && ( CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "felinos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "caninos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "gat") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "perr") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "felinos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "caninos") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "gat") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "perr") ) )
FILTER (?date >= "2012"^^xsd:gYear && ?date <= "2018"^^xsd:gYear) . } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: <http://zaguan.unizar.es/ontologia#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc a ?type . FILTER (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM) .
?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:date ?date .
OPTIONAL { ?doc zaguan:author ?a . ?a zaguan:nombrePersona ?autor . }
OPTIONAL { ?doc zaguan:contributor ?c . ?c zaguan:nombrePersona ?director . }
FILTER ( (BOUND(?autor) && CONTAINS(LCASE(?autor), "lópez")) || (BOUND(?director) && CONTAINS(LCASE(?director), "lópez")) )
?doc zaguan:publisher ?entidad . ?entidad zaguan:nombreEntidad ?nombreEntidad .
FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?nombreEntidad), "informática")) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: <http://zaguan.unizar.es/ontologia#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc a ?type . FILTER (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM || ?type = zaguan:PFC) . ?doc zaguan:title ?title .
?doc zaguan:description ?desc .
?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tema .
FILTER( (CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "arte") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "arte") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "arte") ) && (REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "arag[oó]n(e|es|esa|esas)") || REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "arag[oó]n(e|es|esa|esas)") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "arag[oó]n(e|es|esa|esas)") ) && !CONTAINS(LCASE(?tema), "xx") && !CONTAINS(LCASE(?desc), "xx") && !CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), "xx") ) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: <http://zaguan.unizar.es/ontologia#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc zaguan:title ?title . ?doc zaguan:subject ?subj . ?subj zaguan:nombreTema ?tema . ?doc zaguan:description ?desc .
FILTER( ( ( REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "informátic[oa]") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "informátic[oa]") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "informátic[oa]") || REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "algortimo(s) de búsqueda") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "algortimo(s) de búsqueda") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "algortimo(s) de búsqueda") ) && ( REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "medicina") || REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "proteína(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "síntoma(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?desc), "paciente(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "medicina") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "proteína(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "síntoma(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?title), "paciente(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "medicina") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "proteína(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "síntoma(s)") || REGEX(LCASE(?tema), "paciente(s)") ) ) ) } LIMIT 100
